985-5078-6633-8171.description:

Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.

141-2921-3085.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-3085.description:
Cast Zombify by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Zombify.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Zombify
Resolve the Zombify copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

539-728-792-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-792-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing The Immortal Weapons, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1115-2105-7196.description:
Declare Grub and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks. Grub and Combat Celebrant trigger.

Combat Celebrant dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase, using the Combat Celebrant token instead.

Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

542-2103-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.

Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.

Activate Endless Sands' first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Archaeomancer.
